Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
Hi,
just a question:
I got two (or more) ready untapped couriers, one of my vamps
performs a succesful bleed action:

can i see the top library card of the met just bled with my first courier,
tap it to discard that first card, then see the "new" first card with my
second courier, tap it to discard the "new" first card, and so on ?(with
multiples couriers).

Or the tapping courier(s) ability cannot be used
one after the another on the same (succesful) bleed action?

Thanks in advance
Emiliano, Prince of Rome

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
Tetragrammaton <nospam_a...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:vfhC6.17621$s93.1...@news.infostrada.it...

> I got two (or more) ready untapped couriers, one of my vamps
> performs a succesful bleed action:
>
> can i see the top library card of the met just bled with my first courier,
> tap it to discard that first card, then see the "new" first card with my
> second courier, tap it to discard the "new" first card, and so on ?(with
> multiples couriers).

You can still see the top library card after discarding one with the first
courier's ability.

You can tap multiple couriers to discard multiple cards. [LSJ 1-7-2001]

> Thanks in advance
> Emiliano, Prince of Rome

Carpe Noctem.
